answer: Proof-of-stake acts as a secure haven for decentralized identity validation. By requiring agents to commit capital on a cryptographically verifiable ledge, the network ensures that generating infinite identities is prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to scale fake accounts must acquire significant stake, akin to harvesting yarrow in a vast field where every unit of currency acts as a cost-weighted barrier, rendering high-volume Sybil attacks economically irrational.
